summary: Z(w_p σ) is diagonal with entries p₀, …, p_{ϱ−1}, t.

steps.claim: By frameGram_weylElem_mul, Z(w_p σ) is the diagonal matrix with entries p₀, …, p_{ϱ−1}, t; its determinant is d·t and its leading minor of order ϱ is d. Hence frameDisc(N, Z) = (dt)·conj(dt) − N²·d·d̄ = d d̄ (t t̄ − N²).
